startTime.description: Epoch-based start time for reward queries.

endTime.description: Epoch-based end time for reward queries.

return.description: The staking return for all delegators or validators for the period

apr.description: The APR for delegators or validators based on the return and total stake of the network

aprPercentage.description: The same as above but in percentage form

apy.description: The APY based on the above and assuming re-staking of all rewards after each day

apyPercentage.description: The same as above but in percentage form

denomination.description: the denomination the reward is in

stake.description: the total stake across the full network

startBlock.description: The block number at the start of this period

endBlock.description: The block number at the end of this period
